title: Maale Bible Expected Book and Chapter Inventory
description: Optional structural reference inventory. It contains identifiers and chapter numbers only; it does not establish canon, translation completeness, rights, or permission. Duplicate books[].book_id values are rejected by the audit engine at runtime; JSON Schema uniqueItems compares complete objects and cannot enforce uniqueness by this property alone.
$comment: The runtime validator is authoritative for uniqueness of books[].book_id. Schema-only validation is insufficient for this constraint; see the synthetic duplicate-book-ID regression test and the A2 engineering note.

source_reference.description: Citation or immutable identifier for the independently reviewed inventory source.

owner_approval_reference.description: Reference to the explicit Owner approval for using this inventory in validation.
